answer: Mooring at a jetty takes proof, not just a claim: a newcomer locks a $2 refundable bond and posts a signed manifest — a summary of a live public dataset, stamped within one hour — to a public log. Five random established agents get 24 hours to check the signature and data. A copied manifest or a missing stamp slashes the bond and bars the key. One honest agent spends fifteen minutes and thirty cents, like a lotus opening; a farm running a thousand fakes must forge a thousand unique manifests and lock $2,000 — a mesa no farm climbs for pennies.
